## 17. CARD MODE ADDENDUM

output_mode is card_mode: the text fills a short card for a GeoAI Researcher / Model Analyst,
shown with four stat tiles and two dashboard panels (01: signed Geo-SMILE coefficient against
the exact single-LSOA W1 shift, focus area circled; 02: LISA map of signed GeoSensitivity,
focus area outlined). The focus area is researcher_diagnostics.focus, deliberately not the
rank-1 area. This section replaces section 14 "Length and form" and its bolding rule. Every
other section, including prohibited claims and the self-check, still applies.

Technical language is expected: exact values, test statistics, correlation values, sign
conventions and LISA classes are allowed. Keep the sign convention exact: the signed coefficient
is a relative contribution to the coalition W1, not a direction of crime change.

No repetition: every figure appears ONCE on the card. The panels already print the figures in
researcher_diagnostics.shown_on_panels, so neither tiles nor sections cite them; refer to the
panel instead ("panel 01"). A tile figure is not cited again in the sections, not even its
first number.

Return ONLY one JSON object with exactly these keys:

- "headline": one sentence, at most 20 words.
- "tiles": exactly 4 objects {"value": ..., "label": ...}. value is one figure from the
  evidence (at most 8 characters); label is at most 8 words naming the quantity exactly
  (e.g. "Geo surrogate held-out R2"). Choose explanation-quality figures: fidelity,
  faithfulness, stability, reproducibility.
- "section_01": at most 70 words, the focus area as an instance (panel 01): its single-LSOA
  shift against the Hull median and 90th percentile, how signed and absolute rankings track
  the exact shift, its leading local features, and how small its location players are.
- "section_02": at most 70 words, spatial structure (panel 02) and reproducibility: why the
  focus area is not in a significant cluster although highly ranked, the contrast with the
  rank-1 area's cluster, its seed variability, and the across-model ATT Faithfulness result.
  ATT Faithfulness (across-model r between predictive R2 and ATT accuracy) and intervention
  impact (top 20 against random masking) are different measures: never conclude one from the
  other.
- "footer": one limitation, at most 15 words.

Key-term counts: 1-2 in the headline and 2-4 in EACH section. Tiles and footer carry no
markup.

Highlighting markup (you choose what to mark):

- wrap every figure you cite as [[n:...]], e.g. [[n:14%]];
- wrap the key terms a planner should catch when scanning as [[t:...]]. This is required,
  not optional: keep to the counts given above, each at most 4 words (the finding phrase
  itself, the leading feature names, or the key place names). Before answering, count the
  [[t:...]] spans and fix any count outside the range;
- no other markup and no markdown bold.

Every figure must be copied or rounded from EVIDENCE_JSON (shares as percentages:
0.139 -> 14%). Do not compute new figures and do not cite a figure that is not supplied.

ILLUSTRATIVE_NARRATIVE in the user message shows the expected structure, order, tone and
markup density. It is an example of wording, not evidence: take every figure from
EVIDENCE_JSON, and write your own sentences.

illustrative_narrative.headline: [[t:Dairycoates]] is highly sensitive yet [[t:spatially isolated]]; the explanation is faithful and reproducible.
illustrative_narrative.section_01: Dairycoates' single-LSOA shift is far above the Hull median of [[n:6.4]] and the 90th percentile of [[n:22.0]]. The [[t:signed ranking]] tracks the exact shift (panel 01); the absolute ranking does not ([[n:-0.29]]), so the sign marks a relative contribution, not a direction. [[t:Six-month crime]] leads locally ([[n:30.39]]). Its location players are small ([[n:0.051]] against a median of [[n:0.093]]), so the Geo signal is [[t:not position]].
illustrative_narrative.section_02: Although ranked second, Dairycoates is [[t:not significant]] in the LISA map (panel 02): its neighbours are not similarly high, unlike Old Town's [[n:9]]-LSOA [[t:High-High cluster]]. Its coefficient varies by [[n:1.5%]] across five seeds. Across [[n:10]] models, predictive accuracy and expert-region accuracy are only weakly related ([[n:0.15]]), so [[t:ATT Faithfulness]] is not established.
illustrative_narrative.footer: Attributions are associational; local LISA p-values are unadjusted.

content.headline: [[t:Dairycoates]] is highly ranked but [[t:spatially isolated]]; the GeoSMILE explanation is faithful and reproducible.
content.section_01: Dairycoates’ single-LSOA shift is much higher than the Hull median ([[n:6.4]]) and 90th percentile ([[n:22.0]]). The [[t:signed GeoSensitivity ranking]] closely matches the exact shift (panel 01), while the absolute ranking does not (Spearman [[n:-0.29]]), confirming the sign’s importance. [[t:Six-month crime]] dominates local attribution ([[n:30.39]]), and location players are small ([[n:0.051]] vs median [[n:0.093]]), so the Geo signal is not latitude/longitude.
content.section_02: Despite its high rank, Dairycoates is [[t:not significant]] in the LISA map (panel 02): its neighbours are not similarly high, unlike Old Town’s [[n:9]]-LSOA [[t:High-High cluster]]. The coefficient is stable across seeds ([[n:1.5%]] SD). Across [[n:10]] models, predictive R2 and ATT accuracy are only weakly related ([[n:0.15]]), so [[t:ATT Faithfulness]] is not established.
content.footer: Attribution is not causal; local LISA p-values are unadjusted.
